Alert

Persistent inline banner with a tone icon. Class contract: .rse-alert--<tone>.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Full-width, in-flow banner for page-level or form-level announcements — enrollment windows, deadline notices, validation summaries.

<Alert tone="info" title="Matrículas abertas" message="Garanta a vaga para o ano letivo de 2027." />
<Alert tone="danger" message="Verifique os campos destacados abaixo." onDismiss={() => {}} />

Different from Toast: Alert sits inline in the page flow (bordered all around, no shadow, no auto-dismiss) for persistent messages; Toast floats and is transient. Don't use both for the same message.

role="status" by default, so a banner that is on the page from the start does not interrupt a screen reader. Pass urgent only for a message that must interrupt (a failed submission). The tone shows as an icon as well as a colour.

Without React: <div class="rse-alert rse-alert--warning" role="status"> with .rse-alert__icon, .rse-alert__content > .rse-alert__title + .rse-alert__message.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
tonesuccess warning danger info—
titlestring—
messageReact.ReactNode—The message (children also work)
onDismiss() => void—
urgentboolean—Interrupts screen readers (role="alert"). Default is role="status".
dismissLabelstring—Accessible label of the dismiss button (default "Fechar")

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>, a ref and className.

CSS classes

Blocks
.rse-alert
Elements
.rse-alert__content .rse-alert__dismiss .rse-alert__icon .rse-alert__message .rse-alert__title
Modifiers
.rse-alert--danger (tone) .rse-alert--success (tone) .rse-alert--warning (tone)
